identity.title: Promoting Ensemble Diversity with Interactive Bayesian Distributional Robustness for Fine-tuning Foundation Models
identity.page_convention: one-based PDF pages; printed internal page numbers where equal

scoped_summary: Three demonstrated core problems: determinant minimization favors collapse; normalized binary non-target diversity is constant; Gaussian KL substitution underestimates the correct value. Historical accuracy and full theorem falsity not established.

problems.title: Positive determinant has opposite minimization preference
problems.assumptions: Positive alpha; two particles, three classes; strictly positive probabilities and identical true-label probabilities
problems.check: Exact Gram determinant and equal cross-entropy comparison
problems.result: Collapsed objective .22314355 is below diverse .24292317 at alpha.02
problems.counterevidence: Preserved code uses negative jittered logdet rather than printed determinant; historical correspondence unknown
problems.impact: Printed central diversity mechanism has reversed preference
problems.correction: Correct sign/objective and recheck theorem assumptions; no full repair certified

problems.title: Binary non-target normalization removes diversity signal
problems.claim: Explicit diversity interaction applies in reported binary task
problems.location: PDF pp5–7; Camelyon tables; src/data.py103–108; configs/dro/patch_camelyon.yaml27
problems.assumptions: Binary classes, positive softmax probabilities, hard-label non-target normalization, K4
problems.check: All normalized columns equal1; exact determinant/eigenvalue calculation
problems.result: Printed determinant0; jittered negative logdet46.96799257 is prediction-independent
problems.counterevidence: Other objective components and higher-dimensional tasks can still improve; no reported score disproved
problems.impact: Core diversity mechanism supplies no exact mathematical signal for a reported setting
problems.correction: Specify rank-aware or different diversity representation; no replacement validated

problems.title: Incorrect Gaussian KL term in core bound
problems.assumptions: Q mixture N(mu_i,sigma²I), P N(0,I); d1, allmeans0,sigma.1
problems.check: Exact Gaussian expectation; identical components make mixture inequality equality
problems.counterevidence: Fixed sigma makes difference constant in mean gradients; overall bound may have other slack
problems.impact: Core displayed bound derivation unsupported; not universal theorem falsity
problems.correction: Use sigma²−1−2log sigma; preceding theorem and whole bound remain separately unverified

limitations: Table1 AVG values differ from unweighted means; aggregation convention and raw records unavailable.
